_about: Age x ethnicity/nationality figures for the age selector (schema harm-data/age-bands/v1). Built from official sources; values are never imputed or pro-rated. Category labels are kept as published.

fit_codes.exact: published band(s) add up exactly to the standard band
fit_codes.derived_exact: obtained exactly by adding/subtracting published cells (no assumptions)
fit_codes.computed_microdata: our tabulation of an official record-level file, exact ages
fit_codes.estimated: only an overlapping published band exists; the value shown is for approx_band, never pro-rated
fit_codes.unavailable: no published or computable figure for this band

race_notes: Portugal records nationality (Portuguese / foreign), never ethnicity. Portuguese includes naturalised citizens. Labels as published.
The prison service table is the only official source crossing nationality with age and offence. Police and court statistics (DGPJ) give age without nationality.
The child-protection commissions (CPCJ 2024) give nationality of children with a measure, all dangers and ages combined, so they are not used here.

series.title: Sentenced prisoners by nationality and age: homicide, Portugal, 31 Dec 2024
series.race_basis: Nacionalidade (Portuguese / foreign citizens) as published by the prison service; not ethnicity
series.no_rate_reason: A prison stock on one day; rates not calculated.

18-29.note: The prison table uses one group for 21 and over

series.native_note: DGRSP publishes three age groups for sentenced prisoners: 16-18, 19-20, 21 and over.
notes: Sentenced prisoners held on 31 December 2024 (a stock on one day, not a flow of convictions). Age is age on that date, not at the offence.
Men and women added together. Empty cells in the source = no prisoners (rows add up to the total).
